findings.finding: Production issuance previously exposed an overly broad native executable route; R3 now confines production to the fixed allowlist and moves arbitrary native probes behind a test-only API.
Process-global deterministic pause state could cross-contaminate concurrent tests; controls are now isolated per ledger root.
An empty readiness file was incorrectly classified as a terminal mismatch under parallel load; exact ready-newline prefixes now remain pending.

Path-based authority-root enumeration and final-component-only no-follow opening could miss descriptor-root entries or accept symlinked ancestors; both ledgers now resolve every component without following links and enumerate from the already-open root descriptor with mutation detection.

The R3 research record omitted REQ-RESEARCH-001/002/004 content and allowed incomplete inputs to become eligible; R5 binds a complete canonical typed source record and complete proposal analyses while preserving a no-authority output.

The first R5 draft let uncorrelated checked dates and caller-chosen validity satisfy freshness; checked date now equals the observation epoch UTC day and mutable/version validity is exactly a code-derived 30-day window, with rebound semantic tamper controls.

Independent R5 review proved that a caller could relabel an old non-primary capability fact as stable to select a longer policy; the corrected candidate now applies a fixed 30-day and current-primary policy to every external verified fact, rejects every unsealed stable label with a typed no-authority finding, and covers exact public-API, mixed-fact, rebound, and self-consistent substitutions.

Root pre-freeze falsification proved that the public audit epoch let a caller move now backward; production audit now reads SystemTime directly, deterministic raw epochs are cfg(test)-only, unavailable and invalid clocks fail closed, and old-source backdating, future time, zero, maximum, failure, and same-record validity rebound are covered.

Independent R6 review proved that canonical consistency alone let a public caller simultaneously rebound source class, temporal scope, observation date and time, validity, bytes, and digest into an eligible proposal. R7 separates caller bytes from a private typed authority binding; every production source created through public constructors is conservatively ineligible, while the cfg(test)-only adopted seam binds the exact record digest and all policy-bearing fields. A real downstream-crate probe reproduces the full attack and receives the typed authority-binding-required finding.
